nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Records released versions and user-visible changes to LoRA Fine-tune Studio, including the queue and Unsloth additions.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Defines the development setup, contribution workflow, engineering expectations, and required checks for repository contributors.

nodes.name: Launch LoRA Studio.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that verifies the repository, provisions the standard and native Unsloth environments with uv, then starts and health-checks the Streamlit app.
nodes.languageNotes: Batch control flow uses labels for failure paths and delegates process management to an embedded PowerShell command.

nodes.name: Launch LoRA Studio.sh
nodes.summary: Linux launcher that installs or locates uv, synchronizes the project environment, and starts the Streamlit app with PID and health-check management.
nodes.languageNotes: The shell script uses strict mode and manages the background Streamlit process through a PID file.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview with supported training recipes, requirements, platform-specific quick start steps, and a small smoke-test workflow.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: States supported versions, private vulnerability reporting guidance, local trust boundaries, and safe operating practices for the application.

nodes.name: TECHNICAL.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive technical handbook covering the application architecture, data and training pipelines, job lifecycle, hardware behavior, testing, and extension paths.

nodes.name: USAGE.md
nodes.summary: Step-by-step user guide for configuring access, launching the app, preparing datasets, configuring training, managing runs, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines package metadata, Python and ML dependencies, the installed CLI entry point, uv CUDA package source, and development/documentation dependency groups.
nodes.languageNotes: The uv source override selects the CUDA-enabled PyTorch index while project dependencies retain bounded version ranges.
